run_labgraph_zmq_demo: run the Demo graph that streams ZMQ data and displays a real-time matplotlib bar chart
create_rolling_averager_node: create a RollingAverager node that averages incoming RandomMessage data over a configurable time window
create_zmq_deserializer_node: create a ZMQDeserializer node that converts raw ZMQMessage data into RandomMessage objects
create_averaged_noise_group: create an AveragedNoise group combining ZMQPollerNode, ZMQDeserializer, and RollingAverager nodes
create_plot_node: create a Plot node that renders a real-time matplotlib bar graph from streaming RandomMessage data
